items.stem: What experience does the Actions and Integrations course expect?
Which topics does the workshop cover before the hands-on build?

options.text: Departmental use cases, actions and MCP, then integrations.

items.stem: How does a builder add a custom action to an agent?

options.text: As a step in Agent Builder, with fixed, user, or AI-predicted inputs.
By registering it as an MCP single-step selection.
By attaching it to a connector schedule.

items.stem: Which integration examples appear in the course agenda?

options.text: Client API, resolving tickets in ServiceNow, and embedding in custom web applications.
Data warehouse migration and ETL scheduling.

items.stem: Why plan the custom action target before the session?

options.text: Because custom actions exist for internal APIs, legacy systems, and validation before a write, so the target shapes the build.
Because custom actions cannot be changed after creation.
Because only one custom action may exist per organization.
